provider: Illustrative mapping prepared by the gateway operator, Andrei Besleaga, from the reporting subject's own published EMAS-validated Umwelterklaerung 2025 (environmental statement), validated by EMAS environmental verifier DE-V-0404; NOT published, reviewed, authorized, or endorsed by the reporting subject. Every figure is read from the source document named in methodology-uri. Scope caveats: German sites only (Gunzenhausen, Falkenstein, Nuernberg). carbon-footprint is the COMBINED Scope 1 + Scope 2 market-based figure; no split is published, so scope-1, scope-2 and scope-3 are all omitted. Scope 3 is not yet reported (planned end of 2027). energy-consumption is datacentre electricity only; company-wide consumption adds about 1.8 GWh of conventional supply, giving a company-wide renewable share above 99.5%.
